method: Same alternative garden programme and same observer in both comparisons. Baseline suppresses only pavilion opaque boxes, not the pool/spa rearrangement. Actual pavilion shell includes blank rear/east walls, transparent front/west windows and ground door, opaque floor slabs/roof, entry steps. Existing trees use summer canopy envelopes; these are modeled screening assumptions. Percentages are unweighted point-ray counts, never projected image area or a whole-garden guarantee. Height datum is the lowest original ground corner; no height credit for proposed fill.

roofEnvelope.method: Plan interception of measured roof-point rays; ideal opaque envelope only. Actual glazing, roof and wall screening is reported separately.
